svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The Gibbs phenomenon at a square wave's jump
svg.desc: A close-up of the jump of a square wave from −1 to +1 at t = 0. The partial sums with N = 15 and N = 61 harmonics both overshoot to about 1.18, which is 9% of the jump of 2; the larger N squeezes the ripple closer to the jump but does not lower the peak. The partial sum with N = 61 and Lanczos sigma smoothing overshoots by only about 1.2% of the jump, with a slightly softer edge.
svg.text: Close-up of a square wave's jump at t = 0 (time in periods)
N = 61: peak 1.18, ripple squeezed closer to the jump
N = 61 with Lanczos σ smoothing: peak 1.02 (1.2%)
Time from the jump (fractions of a period T). The square wave runs from −1 to +1; only −0.25 to 1.3 is shown.
